All checks pass. Final summary of the repair:

## What was wrong and what I built

**Diagnosis:** the supplied pipeline assumed a live transport — `star4_switch.c` keyed slots by `psn % capacity` (no logical identity), had no retired prefix/window, no cumulative-ACK prefix rule, no eligible-vs-sent upstream distinction, no budget backpressure, lenient frame acceptance (no ICRC/checksum/endpoint validation), no snapshot/trace support, and `replay_api.c`/`solver.py` drove it through a per-packet Python callback that could not meet the contract or the time budget.

**Implementation (all in the collected source tree):**

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/collector.c` (new, ~1.2k lines) | Offline replay engine: strict wire acceptance (exact length equations, `0x45`, proto 17, IPv4 checksum, flags ∈ {0,DF}, UDP len/ports/zero-csum, BTH opcode/flags/pkey/QPN-top/APSN-top, 4D payload, 4-byte AETH `0x1f`+PSN+1, ICRC) → endpoint validity (MAC/IP/switch-QPN, required source, `p∈[0,K)`) → exactly-one classification per frame; retention window `[b,min(K,b+N))` with logical-`p` slot identity, first-occurrence-wins, blocked/stale/duplicate; `R/E/U`, `sent/down` prefixes, mode-2 safety translation per primitive (incl. gather's mapped output PSNs and scatter's mapped receiver), mode-3 immediate eligibility; repeat-request persistence; retirement on complete+outputs-acked+`U>p`; emission priority (upstream ACKs asc. rank → retry-only retransmission `[down,sent)` asc. q → new results asc. rank,q) with budget rejection ending the opportunity; incremental SHA-256 transcript, FNV1a64 buffer digest, snapshots, trace; in-C expansion of data/count/step/seed/values/xor, ack, wire, budget, flush, retry, snap, train |
| `src/roce_packet.c`, `src/star4_switch.c` | Supplied codec/switch retained (codec verified byte-identical to `wire.py`; switch kept in the build) |
| `include/offline_api.h`, `src/replay_api.c`, `Makefile` | New offline ABI (`epic_case_new/run/result/free`) |
| `solver.py` | Entry point: whole-batch validation first (no compilation on illegal input), compact LE program encoding, one scratch build per invocation (gcc→cc→make), certificate blob decoding, exact JSON out, `os._exit(0)` |

**Verification:** 2/2 public examples; 15 hand-derived scenario checks (mode-2 gating order for allgather/scatter, retry tail retransmission, budget failure/persistence, blocked+stale, barrier empty frames, wrapped PSNs, reduce non-receiver ACKs); 74 illegal-input cases all returning exactly `{"error":"invalid"}`; C event expansion proven byte-identical to `wire.py`; ~1000 randomized differential cases against an independent Python model with structural invariants (`22+23+24+25==18`, overwrites/reserved zero, `U≤R`, `down≤sent`); near-maximal batch (541k work units, 249 MB charged traffic, 1.05 M emitted frames) replays end-to-end in **1.4 s** of the 120 s budget with scratch left clean.
